title: Voice session dropdown title and its folder name no longer match

owner_note.text: Decided: a titled voice session now shows its title in the Switch-session dropdown, but its folder on disk stays named by its voice id (v-xxxxxxx) forever — the two names differ. The alternative (rename the folder to match) was built and dropped: the smart assistant is handed its session's folder path once, at spawn, for the rest of that conversation's item-tool calls, and renaming it would break that agent's own record-keeping the instant it ran. A real fix needs an id-indirection layer that core/Item doesn't have yet (noted there). Also: untitled sessions show their voice id as the label, not a content-derived fallback — that matches your later instruction that the id is a fine default until the topic is clear.
